title: Ricoh GR IV Monochrome Geotagging POV | Philly in Flux

mentions.place: Lehigh Avenue, from 33rd St east to the end of the avenue
mentions.speaker: Dante Sisofo
mentions.quote: so I just hopped off the bus and arrived at 33rd and Lehi Avenue where we're going to start our walk.
mentions.locationEvidence: START: 33rd & Lehigh (0:36). Intent: 'walk the entirety of this street until we reach the end of the street' (0:51); 'I'm going all the way from the top to the bottom' (6:16). END: 'basically just at the end of the street here, Lehi Avenue conquered barefoot' (21:19-21:25) - end cross street NOT spoken. Direction is eastbound by geography (33rd is the west end). Stats from his project page on screen: 114 photographs, 4.2 mi, 2 hours 17 minutes (24:31); ~3 hours and 824 frames by his own count (21:05-21:15). Date said: June 15, 2026 (13:40).
mentions.notes: 4.2 mi matches 33rd St to the avenue's east end at Richmond St (Port Richmond), but 'Richmond St' is my inference, not spoken. 'Lehi' is the caption spelling of Lehigh. Project page: flux.dantesisofo.com/geotag-catalog/lehigh-ave-in-flux/.

mentions.place: McDonald's sign on Lehigh Avenue (about 40 min east of 33rd; near a school and a Save A Lot)
mentions.speaker: Dante Sisofo
mentions.quote: look at this McDonald's sign. This is pretty epic. Let's get a good one of the McDonald's sign.
mentions.locationEvidence: On Lehigh Ave; 'we've been walking for around 40 minutes' (12:31); nearby: 'you got a school, you got a McDonald's sign, you got to freaking save a lot. You got these flag poles' (13:20-13:26).
mentions.notes: Frame clearly made (plays with sign and shadow). Cross street not spoken. Inference only: at his pace 40 min is ~1.2 mi from 33rd, i.e. around 22nd-20th & Lehigh, where Dobbins high school sits - needs checking on a map.

mentions.place: Church cross on Lehigh Avenue (block not stated)
mentions.speaker: Dante Sisofo
mentions.quote: Oh wow, this cross looks insane. 50 mm crop mode with the red filter.
mentions.locationEvidence: Somewhere on Lehigh Ave between 33rd and the McDonald's (6:49, i.e. before the 40-minute mark). 'Photographing with the sun behind the cross' (6:59).
mentions.notes: Frame made, but the church/block is not named; position only bracketed by timing.
